notes.title: Added Keyboard shortcuts, Undo Redo and more
notes.content:
- Added Keyboard shortcuts W,A,S,D,Q,E to pose figure fast
- Added Undo, Redo System per figure
- Added new Woman Shorts
- All figures and items are now saved to json file even if figure is turned off
- Added new shoulder deform system to give more natural movements
- Added new hip deform to female figure when doing splits.
- Added new save system to always save in json format 
- Added improvements to screenshot for Canny Filter used with ControlNet, ComfyUI, Stable Diffusion, Fooocus for posing of A.I. characters.
- Manga /Comic Filter will give you very clean outline drawings.
- Added new button to T-Pose menu to reset 'Selected Bone'.

notes.title: Upgraded camera filter in Main menu
notes.content:
Upgraded camera filter in Main menu:
- Added A.I. Canny Diffusion to be used with ControlNet A.I. Image generation programs like ComfyUI, Stable DIffisuion, Fooocus. Canny is a way to pose A.I. Characters. 
- Manga Comic Filter will give you very clean outline drawings.
- Pencil Sketch Filter will give you shaded figures in red pencil.
- Oil Painting Filter will give your Oil paint look for reference 
- Halftone Filter will give you newsprint style.
-  Screenshots are saved with Filter.

notes.title: March Update: Added more poses and added feature improvements
notes.content:
- Added dozens of new poses. more poses coming with every new update!
- Improved Facial Expressions can now mix and match facial expressions. 
- Improved export OBJ. You can export the scene as an OBJ file to edit in your favorite 3d Editing program for sculpting.
- Background color is saved with a screenshot
- Improved export JSON file to support PC/Mac version of Pose Tool 3D.
- Improved reset button for posed body part. Click this button to reset to the original starting rotation.

notes.title: Added a new batch of poses.
notes.content: Added a new batch of poses. We are working on even more poses for the next update

notes.title: Update Feb 24
notes.content: Added support to the export of OBJ files to always use a period for floating point numbers.

notes.title: Added ZBrush support to OBJ file export
notes.content: Added support for ZBrush export of OBJ file. When you import the exported OBJ file it will display with Normals face out. In Blender you can clear custom normals.
